description.zh-CN: 分析叙事文本，自动识别和跟踪出场角色。
description.en-US: Analyze narrative text to automatically identify and track characters.

schema.description: Create a new character card or update an existing one. Call once per named character found in the narrative.

description.description: Brief one-sentence description of the character based on narrative

type.description: Character type: 'npc' for non-player characters, 'companion' for party members

fields.description: Dynamic field values matching the character field schema (if available). e.g. {"hp": 100, "faction": "云梦泽"}
